content.title: Opening Day Street Fest | Houston Astros
content.text: Celebrate Astros Opening Day at Daikin Park!carousel-arrow-left--_r_f_carousel-arrow-right--_r_g_Come out and cheer on your Houston Astros as they launch the 2026 season on March 26, taking on the Los Angeles Angels at Daikin Park!Before first pitch, join us for Astros Opening Day Street Fest, presented by Budweiser, from 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. Kick off the season with live entertainment, family‑friendly activities, and plenty of Astros excitement.Plus—as gates open—all fans will receive a 2026 Astros Schedule Magnet, courtesy of United Airlines.Opening Day Street Fest HighlightsEnjoy a full lineup of fun, including: Live Music Face Painters & Caricature Artists Photo Booths Inflatables Giveaways Food Trucks Yard Games Grab your limited‑edition 12 oz Astros cans at the Budweiser Container Bar for $1.50 starting at 1:50pm while supplies last Take a photo with Penny the eagle courtesy of Budweiser in Champions Pavilion from 12:00pm - 2:00pm Don’t Miss a Minute!Arrive early to enjoy the festival, then head inside for a special Opening Day pregame ceremony before the Astros take the field.Please note: A March 26 game ticket is required for entry into the Opening Day Street Fest.All times CT.
